title: The dualizing functor on finite length modules over a local ring is the linear dual into the injective hull
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a Noetherian local ring with normalized dualizing complex the dualizing functor on finite length modules is the linear dual into the injective hull of the residue field, in degree zero (author lemma at source lines 3203-3213, label lemma-dualizing-finite-length). The proof (source lines 3215-3229) does a length induction, composes the dual with Matlis duality to get an autoequivalence of finite length modules and identifies it with the identity, then applies the self-inverse property (proof lines 3215-3228). The composition argument is the substance. H3.
